remarks: Springdale 2 bedroom, 3 bath townhouse conveniently located near transportation, shops, and so many restaurants. Enjoy the oversized living room/dining room combo, with satin finished Australian Cypress hardwood floors, fireplace, recessed lighting, and sliders to private rear deck. Sun-drenched updated kitchen with skylight. Full bath on main level. 2nd level has a primary bedroom with new hardwood floors and full ensuite bathroom, and a 2nd bedroom with hardwood floors and private full bath. Lower level is also finished for a great playroom/office/storage space. 1 car private garage plus 1 reserved lot space. Unit also boasts great attic space for storage. Don't miss your opportunity to lease this home for 1-2 years!

facts.laundryLoc: In finished lower level of unit.
